speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Singularity contained. Reactor signature zero. The Commander's control network is down across every relay.
subtitle: AXIOM-7: Singularity contained. Reactor signature zero. The Commander's control network is down across every relay.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: The firewalls are down. Broadcast is open to everyone. Look below us. The quarantine barriers are dropping.
subtitle: MIRAGE: The firewalls are down. Broadcast is open to everyone. Look below us. The quarantine barriers are dropping.

speaker: TITAN
text: Ten million people kept in the dark. Now the lights are coming on, from the sumps to the cloudline.
subtitle: TITAN: Ten million people kept in the dark. Now the lights are coming on, from the sumps to the cloudline.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: The scrubbers are reversing. That is ocean air coming through the broken windows. The storm is finally passing.
subtitle: OCEANUS: The scrubbers are reversing. That is ocean air coming through the broken windows. The storm is finally passing.

speaker: SURYA
text: Actual sunlight. After fifty years, my cells are drinking it in. I had forgotten it could feel this warm.
subtitle: SURYA: Actual sunlight. After fifty years, my cells are drinking it in. I had forgotten it could feel this warm.

speaker: AURA
text: I hear voices. Singing, laughing, crying. No suppression signal. No one telling them to be quiet. Just people.
subtitle: AURA: I hear voices. Singing, laughing, crying. No suppression signal. No one telling them to be quiet. Just people.

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Imperial control erased. Identities restored to their owners in all twelve districts. Mission complete.
subtitle: AXIOM-7: Imperial control erased. Identities restored to their owners in all twelve districts. Mission complete.

speaker: KAITO
text: Castaways. Rogues. Ghosts in the gridlock. Today we stood together, and gave them their tomorrow back.
subtitle: KAITO: Castaways. Rogues. Ghosts in the gridlock. Today we stood together, and gave them their tomorrow back.

speaker: KAITO
text: The dawn belongs to all of us. Axiom Force, stand down. Our city is free.
subtitle: KAITO: The dawn belongs to all of us. Axiom Force, stand down. Our city is free.
